phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Mutex provides mutual exclusion for shared state.**

**Mutex operations:**

| Operation | Code |
|-----------|------|
| Create | `Mutex::new(value)` |
| Lock | `mutex.lock().unwrap()` |
| Unlock | Drop the guard |
| Share ownership | `Arc::new(Mutex::new(value))` |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Mutex allows safe shared mutable state between threads."

**When to use Mutex:**
| Situation | Use Mutex |
|-----------|----------|
| Shared state | ✅ |
| Multiple threads | ✅ |
| Need to mutate | ✅ |
| Simple locking | ✅ |
